compiled_state.title: GREEN: update Sprint SKILL.md Phase F ci-pr story branch merge to use resolve-session-branch.sh and STORY_PR_BASE
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: GREEN

## What
Update plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md Phase F story branch merge block so that in ci-pr mode:
1. Calls resolve-session-branch.sh to obtain SESSION_BRANCH (fail-fast if resolution fails — never silently default to main)
2. Passes SESSION_BRANCH as STORY_PR_BASE env var when invoking merge-to-main.sh
3. After the PR is created and merged into session branch (by CI), the orchestrator calls merge-story-branch.sh locally with the session branch to add the DSO-Story-Merge trailer (so local mode and ci-pr mode both get the trailer on session branch merge commits)

## Specific SKILL.md changes (Phase F, Story branch merge section around line 2013-2040):
Replace the ci-pr mode block:
```bash
if [[ "${SPRINT_MODE:-local}" == "ci-pr" ]]; then
  export BRANCH="$STORY_BRANCH"
  bash "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/merge-to-main.sh" || { ... }
```
With:
```bash
if [[ "${SPRINT_MODE:-local}" == "ci-pr" ]]; then
  # Resolve session branch via 3-step fallback — fail-fast, never default to main
  SESSION_BRANCH=$(bash "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/resolve-session-branch.sh") || {
    echo "ERROR: SESSION_BRANCH resolution failed — cannot open story PR against session branch" >&2
    exit 1
  }
  # Open story/* PR against session branch (not main)
  export BRANCH="$STORY_BRANCH"
  export STORY_PR_BASE="$SESSION_BRANCH"
  bash "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/merge-to-main.sh" || {
    echo "ERROR: merge-to-main.sh failed in ci-pr mode — aborting story merge" >&2
    exit 1
  }
  unset STORY_PR_BASE BRANCH
```

## Note on DSO-Story-Merge trailer in ci-pr mode
In ci-pr mode, the story branch is merged into the session branch by GitHub (via auto-merge on the story→session PR). The merge commit on the session branch is created by GitHub and will NOT automatically carry the DSO-Story-Merge trailer. The S5 provenance verifier uses GitHub API signals as the primary provenance source in ci-pr mode (not the trailer). The trailer is emitted by merge-story-branch.sh only in local mode. Document this distinction in the SKILL.md update (inline comment).

## File impact
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md (Phase F story branch merge block)

## Acceptance
Test 5 from T3 passes GREEN. The SKILL.md block explicitly calls resolve-session-branch.sh and sets STORY_PR_BASE. Code review confirms no silent default to main.
